description: North Central Province - Notifying that Hon. S. M. Ranjith Samarakoon was removed from the Office of Chief Minister of the North Central Provincial Council w.e.f. 28.01.2015. Notifying that Hon. Peshala Jayaratne Bandara was appointed as the Chief Minister of the North Central Provincial Council w.e.f. 28.01.2015
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively concerns government personnel changes - specifically the removal of Hon. S. M. Ranjith Samarakoon as Chief Minister and the appointment of Hon. S. M. Peshala Jayaratna Bandara as Chief Minister. It names specific individuals with their basic titles but does not include any detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities or ministerial duties, making it a People Gazette (Type 2) rather than a Hybrid Gazette (Type 3).
